title: Before you write: read the call and decide go or no-go
course_title: Proposal Writing: Grants and Business Proposals

say: Before you write: read the call, and decide go or no-go.
This is the video for module one of Proposal Writing.
A proposal is a written offer that asks a reader to commit money to your plan. Every proposal answers one question from the reader: why should I trust you with this?

panel.heading: Grant proposal or business proposal?

Ends in a grant agreement and reports

say: A grant proposal goes to a funder, who pays you to create change for other people. For example, Amaka in Lafia trains women to make soap and liquid detergent. She asks a foundation for about 4.8 million naira to train 40 women over 6 months.

panel.heading: Grant proposal or business proposal?
left: A funder pays for change for others
Ends in a grant agreement and reports
right: A client pays for her own need
Wants a deliverable at a fair price
Ends in a signed contract and invoices

say: A business proposal goes to a client who pays for her own need. In the same month, Amaka offers a school 60 litres of liquid soap per month, at an agreed price per litre.
Same skill, two very different documents, because the reader is different.

say: Many proposals are rejected before anyone reads the idea, because the applicant was not eligible or ignored the format. So read the call at least three times: to understand, to mark every rule, and to check your finished draft.

panel.heading: Five things every call tells you
items: Funding: amounts, length, costs not allowed

say: First, the purpose: what change the funder wants, and who should benefit.

panel.heading: Five things every call tells you
items: Funding: amounts, length, costs not allowed

say: Second, eligibility: what type of organisation may apply, its registration, location and years of activity.

panel.heading: Five things every call tells you
items: Funding: amounts, length, costs not allowed

say: Third, funding details: the minimum and maximum amount, the project length, and costs that are not allowed.

panel.heading: Five things every call tells you
items: Funding: amounts, length, costs not allowed

say: Fourth, the evaluation criteria. Reviewers score each section, so these points tell you where to spend your effort.

panel.heading: Five things every call tells you
items: Funding: amounts, length, costs not allowed

say: And fifth, the submission rules: page limits, file type, annexes, and the exact deadline with its time zone.

panel.heading: Five things every call tells you
items: Funding: amounts, length, costs not allowed

say: Make a table with three columns: the requirement, where it is in the call, and its status.

panel.heading: Build a compliance checklist
items: Table: requirement, where in the call, status
Add every rule, line by line
Add each criterion with its points
Mark which section answers each one
Tick every row against the final document

say: Go through the call line by line and add every rule: eligibility, page limit, budget template, annexes, signatures and deadline.

items: Table: requirement, where in the call, status

Add each criterion with its points
Mark which section answers each one
Tick every row against the final document

say: Add every scoring criterion as its own row, with its points.

items: Table: requirement, where in the call, status

say: Mark which part of your proposal will answer each one.

say: Before you submit, tick each row against the final document, not your memory of it. Words like must and required can disqualify you. Plan to submit at least one full day early, because portals slow down near the deadline.

panel.rule: Must means you can be disqualified. Preferred means extra points.

say: Writing a good proposal takes many days, so score the opportunity honestly first. Amaka finds a call for women's economic empowerment, with grants up to 5,000,000 naira for 6 to 12 months.

Her cooperative is registered, has a bank account in its own name, and has run savings groups for four years. Her plan fits the priorities and the funding range. She can meet the deadline, deliver and report.
Five yeses, so the answer is go. Design carries 30 points, so she will spend the most effort there. A clear no is also a good answer. It saves time for a better call.
Funders give money to organisations they believe can manage it. Keep the documents that prove it in one folder.

panel.heading: Your reusable proposal folder
items: Bank account in the organisation's name

say: Your registration certificate, your constitution, and proof of a bank account in the organisation's name. Most funders will not pay into a personal account.

panel.heading: Your reusable proposal folder
items: Bank account in the organisation's name

say: CVs of key staff, and past reports and photos, used only with consent.

panel.heading: Your reusable proposal folder
items: Bank account in the organisation's name

say: Letters of support can take two weeks or more, so request them early.
And make only claims you can prove. Say we trained 85 women in three savings groups, with attendance records, not we are leaders in women's empowerment.

panel.heading: Your reusable proposal folder
items: Bank account in the organisation's name

say: A genuine call is published on the funder's own website, has clear rules, and never charges a fee to apply or to receive money.

panel.heading: A real call or a scam?
left: No fee to apply or receive
right: Asks for your BVN or PIN

say: The same week, Amaka gets a WhatsApp message saying her cooperative has won 10 million naira and must pay 75,000 naira for processing. She never applied, and the funder has no official website. She deletes it and warns her members.
Real funders never charge you to receive a grant. Never share your BVN, PIN or one-time codes.

panel.heading: A real call or a scam?
left: No fee to apply or receive
right: Asks for your BVN or PIN

say: Your practice. Name your first reader and what you will ask for. Find one real call in your field, confirm it on the official website, and turn it into a compliance checklist.
Record your go or no-go decision, and start your proposal documents folder. Now continue with the lessons below.
